title: 第3章 在自己的游戏中获胜第4章 不期而遇
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
沉翔在冰剑城里逛了好一会儿，探索着这座城市，收集了更多的信息，然后购买了地图。这张地图上，记载了冰剑城附近一些山脉的详细信息。和谭长老给的地图对比后，沉翔惊讶的发现两条路线不一样。虽然都是通往同一个目的地，晶石矿，但谭长老提供的地图路线却有些长，有很长的迂回路线。与沉翔刚买的地图相反，上面还有一条小路。
“看来，谭长老是真的想算计我了！”
沉翔心中冷笑。
“我得再用一招来应对诡计，看看他们有什么计划，如果可能的话，屠杀掉那些打算伏击我的人。”
沉翔离开了冰剑城，按照谭长老给他的地图上的路线走。
进入一片森林之后，沉翔确实根据地图找到了一条道路，而且仔细一看，发现这条道路是最近才被挖出来的。察觉到这一点，他更加确定，这是谭长老和魔道宗设下的陷阱。
陆家最厉害的人，乃是魔道宗的家伙，也是那邪术传给陆正南的人。如此看来，陆家不可能不与魔道宗有任何来往。
沉翔并没有沿着那条路走下去，只是在附近的地方警惕地跟在后面。为了进一步保证，他还让龙雪怡多加留意周围的情况。
沿着小路走了半天，龙雪怡忽然大喝道：“我感应到了一股气息，这家伙虽然将气息克制的很好，但是却瞒不过我，这家伙的实力比你强太多了。”
沉翔惊讶地问道：“什么级别？在哪里？”
“他的实力应该是真武境五重，他的力量主要在于真气，是极为坚阳的真气，并且有着极为浓郁的血色气息。”
龙雪怡道：“我感觉他藏在地底下，应该是专攻刺杀的。”
真武境五重！如果沉翔真的遭到伏击的话，那就真的很危险了。
“应该是魔阳一族的魔阳真气。魔阳一族在魔道宗门中的地位，与太武宗差不多，算是魔道宗中最强的宗门了。虽然魔道宗与正宗冲突不少，很少敢侵占正宗的矿山，魔州是不是缺资源了？”
白悠悠疑惑的问道。
魔州面积虽然不小，但魔道大宗门不少，小宗门更是数不胜数。虽然都是走魔道，但是仍然需要大量的资源。
“杀还是不杀？”
沉翔向苏媚瑶等人询问了意见。
“别杀他，吞噬他！”
白悠悠冷冷一笑。沉翔震惊了，竟然用【噬魔术】将对手吞没，何况还是真武境五重的武者，比他还要高出好几个层次！

“现在你的体质比以前好了很多，身体能够容纳大量的真气，不用担心会被炸死！”
白悠悠向他保证。
沉翔点点头。他现在已经是真武境二重了，而他的真正实力，已经快要逼近真武境四重了。他和真武境五重的武者，并没有太大的差距。而且，他现在是在荒野之中，这里并没有其他人。对方是魔道宗的邪弟子，沉翔可以放心使用【噬魔术】。
“虽然【噬魔功】应该见不到天日，但该用的时候，就该用，刻不容缓！”
白幽幽说道。
沉翔点了点头，按照龙雪怡的指引，小心翼翼地向前走去，默默地在树上的树林中穿梭。没有发出丝毫的声音，沉翔悄无声息的接近了埋伏者。
content_en:
Chen Xiang walked around Bingjian City for a long time, exploring the city, collecting more information, and then purchased a map. This map records the detailed information of some mountains near Bingjian City. After comparing it with the map given by Elder Tan, Chen Xiang was surprised to find that the two routes were different. Although they all lead to the same destination, the crystal mine, the map route provided by Elder Tan is a bit long, with long circuitous routes. Contrary to the map Chen Xiang just bought, there is a small road on it.
"It seems that Elder Tan really wants to plot against me!"
Chen Xiang sneered in his heart.
"I'll have to deal with the ruse one more time, see what their plans are, and if possible, massacre those who plan to ambush me."
Chen Xiang left Bingjian City and followed the route on the map given to him by Elder Tan.
After entering a forest, Chen Xiang did find a road according to the map, and after a closer look, he found that this road had only been dug out recently. Realizing this, he became even more certain that this was a trap set by Elder Tan and the Demonic Dao Sect.
The most powerful person in the Lu family is the guy from the Demonic Dao Sect, and he is also the one who passed on the evil magic to Lu Zhengnan. From this point of view, it is impossible for the Lu family not to have any dealings with the Demonic Dao Sect.
Chen Xiang did not go down that road, but followed vigilantly nearby. For further assurance, he also asked Long Xueyi to pay more attention to the surrounding situation.
After walking along the path for a long time, Long Xueyi suddenly shouted: "I sensed an aura. Although this guy controlled the aura very well, he couldn't hide it from me. This guy is much stronger than you."
Chen Xiang asked in surprise: "What level? Where?"
"His strength should be at the fifth level of the True Martial Realm. His strength mainly lies in his true energy, which is extremely strong and yang true energy, and has an extremely rich blood-colored aura."
Long Xueyi said: "I feel that he is hiding underground and he should specialize in assassination."
Fifth level of Zhenwu Realm! If Chen Xiang was really ambushed, it would be really dangerous.
"It should be the Mo Yang Zhenqi of the Mo Yang Clan. The Mo Yang Clan's status in the Mo Dao Sect is similar to that of the Taiwu Sect, and it is considered the strongest sect in the Mo Dao Sect. Although the Mo Dao Sect has many conflicts with the Zhengzong, they rarely dare to invade the Zhengzong's mines. Is the Mo State short of resources?"
Bai Youyou asked doubtfully.
Although the area of ​​the Demon State is not small, there are many large sects of the Demonic Way and countless small sects. Although they all follow the magic path, they still require a lot of resources.
"To kill or not to kill?"
Chen Xiang asked Su Meiyao and others for their opinions.
"Don't kill him, devour him!"
Bai Youyou smiled coldly. Chen Xiang was shocked, he actually used [Devouring Magic] to engulf his opponent, not to mention that he was a warrior at the fifth level of the True Martial Realm, several levels higher than him!
"Your physique is much better now than before. Your body can hold a large amount of Qi, so you don't have to worry about being blown up!"
Bai Youyou assured him.
Chen Xiang nodded. He is now at the second level of the True Martial Realm, and his true strength is approaching the fourth level of the True Martial Realm. There is not much difference between him and a warrior at the fifth level of the True Martial Realm. Moreover, he is now in the wilderness, and there is no one else here. The opponent is an evil disciple of the Demonic Dao Sect, so Chen Xiang can use [Devouring Magic] with confidence.
"Although [Demon Devouring Technique] should never see the light of day, when it's time to use it, you should use it without delay!"
Bai Youyou said.
Chen Xiang nodded, followed Long Xueyi's guidance, and walked forward cautiously, silently walking through the trees and woods. Without making the slightest sound, Chen Xiang quietly approached the ambusher.
